text: Drive REVEL, S.L. (CIF B87883468, Madrid), the Spanish car-subscription company behind the REVEL brand, was founded in Madrid in 2020 and co-founded by Enrique de Mateo (CEO) and Daniel Marcos; in September 2023 it raised EUR 115 million, of which EUR 15 million was equity from investors including KKR and Santander Consumer Finance, which entered its shareholding at undisclosed percentages.

source.name: TechCrunch: Revel, the car subscription startup from Spain, raises $123M to take its business up a gear
source.quote: The funding is a combination of debt and equity: €100 million is structured financing earmarked to build out the car network, and €15 million is equity invested in the business itself. Investors include KKR, Santander Consumer Finance
